note: The corpus's first bidirectional design, and cross-language coverage for hif-backend#71: a VHDL inout port driven by a process was emitted as a bare Verilog inout - a net - while the process assigned to it procedurally, so the regenerated design did not elaborate while hif2verilog exited 0 and verilog2hif reparsed it cleanly. Nothing here could have caught it; every other design in the corpus is in/out only. The testbench is the second device on the pin, without which none of release, sample or contention is observable.
